design_description: A classic football design for Royal Monceau Football Club, featuring bold navy blue and white vertical stripes accented by thin red pinstripes. The traditional striped pattern extends seamlessly across the front, back, and sleeves, creating a timeless look with a modern edge. A navy-and-white round collar, matching club crest, and prominent white sponsor logo complete the shirt. The back features large white player names and numbers with navy outlines, while solid navy shorts provide a clean, balanced finish. A heritage-inspired kit combining elegance, tradition, and club identity.
